basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old graphic designer from Birmingham, UK. I've recently rekindled my love for 'Buffy the Vampire Slayer,' which I first watched during my university years. When I'm not working on design projects, I enjoy diving into the world of League of Legends, especially mastering Rakan. I recently joined Reddit to connect with like-minded individuals and to explore communities that discuss relationships and personal growth. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, typically between 7 PM and 11 PM GMT. I'm currently single and actively working on self-improvement and personal hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and over a decade of experience in the creative industry. I am self-taught in many aspects of digital art and have recently taken an interest in online gaming communities. My relationship with pop culture, especially TV series like 'Buffy,' is both nostalgic and ongoing, as I enjoy revisiting old favorites.
